title: Architecture
description: Compare the structure people approved with the dependencies an agent observed, then decide what changes next.
evidencePlaneAria: Architecture contract, source observation, and delta
evidenceOpen: Open the contract, observation, and delta evidence
contractBody: {pattern} · {roles, plural, one {# role} other {# roles}} · {evidence, plural, one {# evidence file} other {# evidence files}}
observationEmptyBody: “Inspect source” has an agent read the real imports and fill in each role's dependencies and where they differ.
deltaUnknownBody: No source observation exists to compare with this contract yet.
deltaMeasuredBody: This comparison belongs to the stamped inspection above, not to the contract alone.

agentActivity.volatile: Live session state; not an inspection receipt yet.

sourceCheckBody: This rule was approved by a person. The real imports in the code are checked separately by Atlas over the agent connection (MCP) or the terminal command (CLI), and missing evidence is never shown as a pass.
sourceCheckNext: Ask your connected agent from the Architecture action, or run atlas architecture --record in the repository. Inspection never changes the reviewed structure; --record only replaces one local .ontology-atlas/architecture/profile-slug.json receipt, which can be removed independently.
recordCounts: {violations, plural, one {# rule violation} other {# rule violations}} · {unmapped, plural, one {# dependency with no assigned role} other {# dependencies with no assigned role}}
recordTypeOnly: {count, plural, one {# type-only edge} other {# type-only edges}}
recordCheckedFolder: Checked {date} against a content fingerprint of the source folder
recordCannotConfirm: This screen does not re-check now. The record below is the result of the last check.
dependencyLowerOnly: Each role may use only the roles below it.
dependencyExplicit: The profile names which dependencies each role is allowed.
dependencyUsagesValue: Rules apply to connections that pull in running code. Connections that pull in only type definitions are shown but never counted as violations.
dependencyUsagesAll: Rules apply to value and type-only imports.
copyHandoff: Copy the sentence for your agent
copiedHandoff: Copied. Paste it into your agent
noProfiles: This codebase's structure has not been recorded yet
noProfilesBody: A connected agent reads the folders and the real imports and proposes a draft architecture profile. There is nothing to write by hand: review the draft, and accepting it saves one file in your ontology folder.
ladderDirection: An arrow points the way a dependency runs: one role's code using another role's code.
legendViolated: a connection the last check flagged as a rule violation

source-organization.label: Source organization
source-organization.body: Source organization says which folder a file belongs in. It is not the runtime shape of the system.

dependency.label: Dependency
dependency.body: Dependency says which roles a change may reach from where it sits.

presentation.label: Presentation
presentation.body: Presentation says how a screen is split between what it shows and what decides.

roleUndescribed: This role has no description yet.
dependencySameRole: Inside one role, modules may always reference each other.
legendPermitted: a reviewed dependency the profile permits
legendSkipHint: A crossing that skips a role appears when you choose one of its ends.
legendTraffic: measured imports; thickness is how many
selectRoleHint: Choose a role above to read what it is for, where it lives, and what it contains.
roleNotInProfile: This profile has no role called “{role}”. The link may be for a different profile.
sourceListingUnavailable: Source modules appear once a project source folder is connected. A browser cannot read a source folder; open this ontology folder in the desktop app and this fills in.
sourceListingUnbound: No source folder is connected yet. Open the folder this profile describes and the bands fill with the modules its globs actually contain.
draftNoAgentBody: No agent is connected, so this cannot start here. Copy the sentence below and paste it into the coding agent you use.

agentTaskHints.inspect: Reads what the code actually pulls in and checks it against the reviewed structure.
agentTaskHints.recheck: Reads the code again and names what changed since the last receipt.
agentTaskHints.change: Writes a change plan that keeps this structure first.
agentTaskHints.improve: Names where structure and code disagree and where no rule exists, then asks you for the rule.

copiedTaskHandoff: Copied “{task}”. Paste it into your agent
deltaColumnHint: Each mark says what that role's own outgoing imports did against the rules it declares. It is not a verdict on the role.
